title: Dove launches a fine fragrance inspired by its iconic beauty bar
summary: Dove is turning one of beauty's most recognizable scents into a fine fragrance. The brand has bottled the signature scent of its iconic bar soap in a limited-edition launch. Created in collaboration with fragrance developer Ann Gottlieb, the new fragrance translates the familiar scent of the Dove Original Beauty Bar into a wearable format, with a soft, clean and familiar olfactory profile.
